title: Polyverse LoL Esports scoring (transparent)
not_copied: Letter grades and numeric ratings are Polyverse-defined. They are not tak_01_ / third-party unpublished scores.

formulas.team_strength_elo: Sequential hierarchical Elo over OE maps ordered by date: strength = L[home_league] + T[team]. Predict then update (no lookahead). Cross-league maps move league ratings. Half-life decay toward prior.
formulas.strength_grade: Percentile of strength_elo among home-league peers with ≥ min team games, mapped to letters: S≥90, A≥75, B≥55, C≥35, D≥15, else F.
formulas.drafting_proxy: For each map, residual = result - p_pre where p_pre is pre-update Elo win probability. Team drafting_proxy = mean residual in window. Ranked among tier peers for grade. LABEL: proxy only — does not claim causal draft quality; can reflect prep, form, or variance. Opponent-adjusted by construction via p_pre.
formulas.player_rating: Role-adjusted mean of peer percentiles (after Bayesian shrinkage toward role mean with k=8): carry roles use KDA, GD@15, damage share, gold share; jungle adds vision; support emphasizes vision. Displayed on 0–100 scale = 100 × mean percentile.
formulas.laning: 100 × mean of GD@15 and CSD@15 peer percentiles (role peers).
formulas.gd15_display: Player mean golddiffat15 and its role-peer percentile.
formulas.strengths_weaknesses: Strengths: metrics with peer percentile ≥70 (top 2). Weaknesses: metrics with peer percentile ≤30 (bottom 2). Tied to measured fields only.
formulas.off_meta: v1.1 pb-presence-v1: PB% = (# maps with champ picked or banned, deduped) / eligible draft-complete maps in tier peer window through OE detail cutoff. Off-meta if PB% < 1% and window N adequate. Role-pick share is NOT used. Fearless series locks not separately available in OE.
formulas.off_role: Separate flag vs champion modal role among season players; never inferred from bans.
formulas.signature_picks: Team role over-index vs role baseline — not off-meta.
formulas.drafting_proxy_unchanged: Drafting grade remains opponent-adjusted Elo residual proxy; it does not use champion rarity/PB%.
formulas.side_pick_order: Win-loss by Blue/Red × firstPick (1st/2nd) × series game number G1–G5 from OE firstPick + game fields.
formulas.tiers: majors vs academy_erl classified from home league; Challengers/Academy orgs stay distinct from main teams.
formulas.confidence: insufficient / low / medium / high from sample size vs min games.
